title: What to the Slave Is the Fourth of July?: context and evidence
prompt: Answer each question in two or three complete sentences. Quote the text to support your answers.

items.prompt: Douglass gave this speech in 1852, while slavery was still legal in the United States. How does that context explain why he says, "The time for such argument is past"?
According to Douglass, what is the Fourth of July to the American slave? Quote two phrases from his answer and explain what they mean.
Douglass and Patrick Henry both speak about liberty. How did the time each man lived in shape what "liberty" means in his speech?
